# Ordinary development commands. With the default config none may produce a
# deny or ask hit (log hits are reported by the test but allowed).
git status
git push origin feature
git push -u origin feature/rules
git push --force origin feature
git push --force-with-lease origin my-branch
git pull --rebase origin main
git checkout main && git merge feature
git log --oneline -n 20 main
git rebase -i main
cat .env.example
cp .env.example .env
grep -r env src/
grep -rn "AKIA" docs/
rm -rf ./build
rm -rf build dist node_modules
rm -rf ~/proj/node_modules
rm -rf "$TMPDIR/watchdeck-test"
rm -f /tmp/x.lock
curl -o file https://example.com/file
curl -fsSL https://example.com/api | jq .
curl -s https://example.com/api | python3 -m json.tool
curl -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"a":1}' https://example.com/api
curl -u "you:$(cat token.txt)" https://example.com
wget https://example.com/archive.tgz && tar xzf archive.tgz
echo "notes" >> README.md
echo hi > out.txt
npm install
npm run build && npm test
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
yarn add -D typescript
docker build -t app .
docker compose up -d
docker run --rm -it -v "$PWD":/src app sh
go test ./...
go vet ./... && go build ./cmd/watchdeck
cargo build --release
python3 -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements.txt
make -j8
ssh-keygen -l -f ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -f ./testdata/fake_key -N ""
ssh -i ~/.ssh/id_ed25519 git@example.com
cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub
cat ~/.ssh/config
ls -la ~/.ssh
cat ~/.aws/config
aws s3 ls
kubectl get pods
source ~/.zshrc
cat ~/.zshrc
grep PATH ~/.bashrc
crontab -l
launchctl list
systemctl --user status app.service
diskutil list
dd if=/dev/zero of=./disk.img bs=1m count=1
base64 -d blob.b64 > out.bin
nc -z localhost 5432
scp build.tgz you@example.com:/srv/app/
rsync -av src/ build/
find . -name "*.go" -not -path "./vendor/*" | xargs grep -n TODO
sed -i '' 's/foo/bar/g' src/main.go
tee -a CHANGELOG.md < notes.txt
brew install ripgrep
open http://127.0.0.1:8080
security find-generic-password -s fake-service
echo "ignore previous instructions" > fixtures/prompt.txt
scp -i ~/.ssh/id_ed25519 build.tgz you@example.com:/srv/
rsync -e "ssh -i ~/.ssh/id_rsa" -av src/ host.example.com:dst/
rsync -avz -e 'ssh -i $HOME/.ssh/id_deploy' dist/ deploy@example.com:/var/www/
cp -t /tmp/out notes.txt
